dict.string: Sekitiri records your microphone during meetings so you can transcribe them later. Audio stays on this Mac.
Sekitiri records system audio (the other side of your meetings) so you can transcribe them later. Audio stays on this Mac.
Sekitiri uses your calendar to detect meetings and attach titles and attendees to your local notes.
Sekitiri reads your calendar to detect meetings, send reminders, and attach titles and attendees to local notes.
Sekitiri checks the active Chrome or Safari tab only to recognise a meeting link and offer a recording reminder. It never reads page contents.
